item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of Guangdong tomorrow morning. Temperatures will fall over the region. Under the influence of the associated dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine with cool mornings over the region midweek this week. A warm and humid southerly airstream is expected to affect southern China gradually towards the weekend and early next week. Temperatures will rise over the region. There will be a few showers.
